static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends and classmates providing emotional support, but finds it hard to discuss the divorce and its impact on parenting with them
static_traits.medical_history: without类似心理问题经验，not yet接受心理治疗，No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，逻辑较好，配合度高，能自我Reflection，态度积极，愿意尝试行为实验

basic_info.main_problem: I have been troubled by the thought 'my child may see me as a bad dad because of the divorce', which brings me marked distress.
basic_info.core_demands: These thoughts are affecting my mental health and my relationship with my child. I want to work through these feelings and improve communication with my child.
growth_experiences: About a year ago, after divorcing my spouse, stress rose markedly, sleep and self-care were affected; my relationship with the children became tense, and I frequently experience guilt and sadness; academic performance declined slightly; although I have the emotional support of a few friends and classmates, it is hard to proactively talk about the divorce and its impact on parenting.

core_beliefs: 离婚说明我失败了，孩子的痛苦是我的错

special_situations.event: 上周末与孩子在公园玩耍
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子心里责怪我或not开心，就说明我是失败的父亲
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在互动中格外谨慎，Repression情绪并减少玩耍以避免“出错”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定在责怪我让家庭not再完整，他们觉得我是个坏爸爸

special_situations.event: 孩子询问“为什么爸爸妈妈not能在一起”
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子提出离婚的问题，就意味着他们认为是我的错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 立即进行解释，并反复安抚与保证“我们依然爱你们”

special_situations.event: 在与孩子计划活动或相处前后
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果每次相处not够完美，就会证明我是坏爸爸
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度计划、投入更多时间与关注来弥补与证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这次如果not够好，他们会更讨厌我、将来会疏远我

special_situations.event: 离婚后Being aloneReflection父职与家庭破裂
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有维持完整的家庭才算好父亲，否则就是失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过加倍陪伴与照料孩子来证明自己是好父亲
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 离婚就等于我是一个坏爸爸

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被孩子认可、保持亲密连接并被视为“好父亲”
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被孩子责怪或拒绝，害怕被定义为“坏父亲”
defense_goal: 通过过度照顾与解释来维持安全感与认可
在互动中保持克制以避免引发not满或责怪

object_relations.self_representation: 内疚的、可能被责怪的失败父亲
object_relations.object_representation: 会审判或责怪自己的孩子

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当孩子询问为什么爸爸妈妈not能在一起时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将孩子的理解性Questioning视为对自己的责怪与negate（移情：把孩子看作审判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responds in a calm, rational, explanatory tone, emphasizing facts and assurances, minimizing emotional self-exposure as much as possible, avoiding talking about feelings of self-blame.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 与孩子玩耍时突然涌起内疚与悲伤的情绪
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把孩子的普通表现误读为not满或拒绝（移情：自我贬低地解读他人立场）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lowers enthusiasm for interaction, maintains superficially normal communication, with a light and brief tone, avoiding expressing inner emotions.

manifestations: 离婚导致家庭结构变化，亲密关系的距离感增加
难以与朋友和同学讨论离婚与教养的感受
outcomes: 与孩子的互动受影响，出现疏离

manifestations: 将自我价值过度绑定于“是否是好父亲”的评价
把离婚简化为对自身整体价值的negate
outcomes: 学业专注下降，生活质量受损

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度在意孩子对自己的看法与评价
频繁自责为“坏爸爸”，在互动中过于谨慎小心

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 在公园因内疚而变得疏离、减少玩耍
将亲近和玩耍的冲动转化为自我Repression与Withdrawal

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of being with children or planning activities, the client usually falls into the thought 'the children blame me', produces guilt and sadness, and becomes distant in the interaction.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 上周末在公园，孩子们专注玩耍、看起来很开心，have not表现出not满或责怪的迹象；来访者注意到了这些积极反应。
exception_events.reason: not同情境：户外游戏、孩子自然的积极反馈；做法not同：来访者投入陪伴并尝试观察记录；支持线索：孩子当下的愉悦与投入为现实证据。

positive_force: Strong fathering motivation and ongoing actions of accompanying the child (proactively arranging activities, investing time)
愿意寻求咨询并参与行为实验，具备自我Reflection能力
能够以温和方式解释离婚并给予孩子稳定的情感安抚
negative_force: 读心术与预测not yet来倾向，过度将孩子的反应解读为责怪
非黑即白式自我标签（把离婚等同于“坏爸爸”）
内疚与悲伤导致睡眠与自我照料下降
难以与朋友同学谈及离婚与教养困扰，社会支持的use受限

target_behavior.behavior: 与孩子相处时出现疏离与减少玩耍（互动热情下降）
antecedent: 与孩子一起活动（如在公园）
在计划与孩子的活动之前或期间
target_behavior.core_reason: 将孩子的Questioning与普通行为解读为责怪自己，trigger内疚与Anxiety，从而降低互动投入
target_behavior.function: 逃避被责备的情绪与减少Anxiety（消极Reinforcement）
target_behavior.consequence: 亲子互动质量下降，关系更紧张，进一步Reinforcement负性信念

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep impaired与Decreased attention（情绪性生理与行为反应）
antecedent: 反复思考离婚与孩子对自己的看法
与孩子相处后持续反刍负性念头
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化与读心术导致持续性负性反刍与唤醒水平升高
target_behavior.function: 试图通过担忧来预防负面评价的发生（not适应性Self-monitoring）
target_behavior.consequence: 学业表现略下降、日常自我照料受影响、疲劳加重
